Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent

Interface AgentRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
AgentRepositoryAdapter
public interface AgentRepository
Domain repository port for the Agent aggregate (design §4.1).

Pure Java — no Spring annotations. The adapter implementing this interface lives under infrastructure/persistence/adapter/ and bridges to Spring Data JPA.

The interface covers every read/write the EPIC-06 use cases need:

  • CRUD via findById(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.AgentId), save(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.Agent), delete(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.AgentId);
  • owner-scoped paging via listByOwner(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.user.UserId, com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.shared.Cursor, int);
  • pre-flight checks for the three repository-backed invariants — duplicate-name (existsByOwnerAndName(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.user.UserId, com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.AgentName) / existsByOwnerAndNameExcludingId(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.user.UserId, com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.AgentName, com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.AgentId)), cross-owner team member (findOwnerOf(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.AgentId)), nested team (hasNonEmptyTeam(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.AgentId)).

  • Method Details

    • findById

      Optional<Agent> findById(AgentId id)

    • listByOwner

      Page<Agent> listByOwner(UserId ownerId, Cursor cursor, int pageSize)
      Returns one page of agents owned by ownerId, ordered newest-first ((createdAt, id) DESC). Mirrors ApiKeyRepository.listAll keyset shape.

    • existsByOwnerAndName

      boolean existsByOwnerAndName(UserId ownerId, AgentName name)
      Backs the duplicate-name pre-flight on POST /agents (US-06-004). REQ-AGT-002 — name is unique per owner only, not globally.

    • existsByOwnerAndNameExcludingId

      boolean existsByOwnerAndNameExcludingId(UserId ownerId, AgentName name, AgentId excluded)
      Same as existsByOwnerAndName(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.user.UserId, com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.AgentName) but ignores the agent identified by excluded. Backs the duplicate-name pre-flight on PUT /agents/{id} (US-06-007), where renaming an agent back to its own current name must not collide with itself.

    • findOwnerOf

      Optional<UserId> findOwnerOf(AgentId id)
      Returns the owner of id without loading the full aggregate. Backs the cross-owner team-member check (REQ-AGT-012). Optional.empty() when the agent does not exist.

    • hasNonEmptyTeam

      boolean hasNonEmptyTeam(AgentId id)
      Returns true if id has at least one team member. Backs the single-level-team check (REQ-AGT-013).

    • save

      Agent save(Agent agent)
      Upserts the aggregate. The adapter is responsible for keeping the three side tables (agent_tools, agent_mcp_servers, agent_team) consistent with the supplied aggregate atomically.

    • delete

      void delete(AgentId id)
      Hard-deletes the agent. Conversations and messages cascade via the V001 FK chain. A non-existent id is a silent no-op at this layer; the use case is responsible for surfacing 404.
